description: This file defines extension methods for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application, including registration of MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, security components, JWT authentication, and logging setup.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for configuring application services such as MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures and registers core application services, including MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, password hashing, JWT token generation, and current user accessor.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication with token validation parameters, including security key, issuer, audience, and event handling for token message processing.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging with console sink and integrates it into the ASP.NET Core logging pipeline.
